answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial that derives their rate-limit nullifier. A valid message proves membership without exposing identity; two distinct messages exceeding the epoch limit under the same nullifier expose Shamir shares that reconstruct the private key. The network verifies the recovery proof and instantly slashes the bonded collateral, making Sybil identities costly to sustain in the garden, even at nadir load or amid timber-fueled traffic.
